column5: Ah, verbose as always.
It greatly saddens me–
You are always sad.
It further saddens me, dear audience, to inform you all, that misfortune has befallen your main entertainer, our beloved clown.
Oh no!
It is wickedness that has cursed them, as they have managed to lose their precious emotions.
How dreadful!
In their current state, they would hardly be able to make anyone laugh.
It truly is almost enough to make *me* weep.
However, all is not lost, as there is a way for our beloved clown to gain back what has been lost.
Oh, how wonderful!
Tragedy, you must speak faster, before I have the chance to lose my brilliance, and turn into a poor, bitter, sorrow–
*ahem*
–before I turn into my charmingly melancholic partner, would you explain how our spiritless clown may be able to solve this dire situation?
Twice they must try and push themself to reach the curtains that overlay our current Big Top.
The climb will be a trial, terrible and punishing, one that does not guarantee no injuries.
How foreboding! You will scare our dear audience too much like that!
They do have many skills at their disposal!
They are a skilled and strong acrobat who can run, jump–
And even once more to leap through the air!
–twirl, floating them to podiums further away, and even jump off some of the stage walls.
And they are not alone!
Despite my own desires.
Our wonderful audience may guide them through these trials!
The first of which is to choose whose trial to complete first.
